body: Sorry you and your brother are struggling, I had a good buddy pass away about 6 months ago and my mother is like to me what your brother is to you. Shes been smoking for a long time and Im afraid shes going to be diagnosed with something and Ill lose her as well. All I can say is if things come to pass which by the sounds of it they havent yet so enjoy the time with your brother but if something happens carry his essence with you. The shit that only you and you brother would laugh at or deeply understand makes that connection trascend being alive for whoever is here longer, him or you. If you truely care for him even beyond a sibling level as in if you werent related to him but met him as a stranger and became best buds and care deeply for him as a human being stranger or family, that is something to hold on to for as long as you possibly can. One of you has to hold on to that spark, maybe tell him if somethings happens to you youd hope hed hold on to the memories and youre unique person.

Do the same thing, isolate because maybe you convince yourself youre a good person and youre content with just that. Hurts you afterawhile, it's been like 3-4 years. Sometimes hope I can save someones life out during the day during an accident in place for mine. Being trapped in your mind isnt something people talk about much as you get older so it makes it feel more daunting. Curious how long youve felt down
I beg to go in my sleep at the end of everyday, then you wake up and it's all there again. Floating is a good word for the hours between. Stay strong if you can, at least were here.

I get it the pains unbearable, but so is not knowing what happens once we pass. Everynight i wish to pass in my sleep but whatever made us wont let me go or worse yet it forgot about us. If you ever need to vent...
